en.t: I explained it to her in detail:
In any case, you cannot stay at the temple,

units.source_text: 回故乡嘛，又不是农家女。

en.t: and as for going back to your hometown, you are not a farm girl.

units.source_text: 一个女人到东京来，不会有好结果的。

en.t: If a woman comes to Tokyo on her own, nothing good will come of it.

units.source_text: 想依靠大连的婶婶，更是大错特错。

en.t: Thinking you can depend on your aunt in Dalian is even more mistaken.

units.source_text: 按你的脾气，你不能嫁给有父母兄弟的人家。

en.t: With your temperament, you cannot marry into a family that has parents and brothers.

units.source_text: 这一点，道子本人也是心里有数的……”

en.t: Michiko herself understands that perfectly well too...”
